measuredScope.cpuAccounting: cumulative totalCpuDeltaMs sums latest observed lifetime ticks (utime + stime) per (pid, starttime) across all discovered semantic trees as a sampled lower bound; intervalCpuDeltaMs measures delta ticks across consecutive ~100ms intervals with newly discovered processes baselined on first observation to avoid charging multi-second startup work to single sample rate denominators; intervalCpuPct is defined as (intervalCpuDeltaMs / elapsedMs) * 100.0 where 100% equals 1 logical CPU core
measuredScope.rssAccounting: procfs /proc/<pid>/statm resident pages * _SC_PAGESIZE for non-zombie live processes across discovered semantic trees

measuredScope.inspectedActorHandles: cold, warm_main, warm_peer, hostile (directly held SemanticSessionHandle instances)
measuredScope.browserWsSessionStatus: UNMEASURED (browser WS-created sessions not directly held as session handles in harness; explicitly unmeasured, not fake 0)
measuredScope.queueSlotSemantics: occupied and reserved slots in bounded mpsc channels, excluding active writer in write syscall
measuredScope.childOutboundBytesSemantics: child outbound buffered/reserved payload bytes, excluding active writer in write syscall
measuredScope.sampledConcurrentPeakSemantics: completion-boundary sequential handle observations during sustained loop, not atomic concurrent hardware snapshot; authoritative transition highwaters are preserved per-session in maxPerSessionPeaks

before.scope: whole-host context, not isolated workload CPU

after.scope: whole-host context, not isolated workload CPU
